summary: This paper develops metric geometry for the quantum variation of information d_Q(A_i,A_j) = S(A_i|A_j)+S(A_j|A_i) restricted to MET_n, comparing the classical chain CUT_n <= SUB_n <= VI_n <= POLY_n against quantum/entanglement cones M_n^{cb,+} <= M_n^{q,+} <= M_n^q <= Q_n. Independent verification from the PDF confirms Proposition 1.3 (purification reduction to 896 SSA+WM inequalities at n=7), the exact n<=6 phase hierarchy (296 MET_6 rays in CB_6^+, 1736 POLY_6 rays in 12 rank-14 orbits, Table 2 D4 Farkas certificate and explicit h in Gamma_6 for kappa_{POLY_6}(K_{3,3}-e)=9/8, and Orbit 9 Zhang-Yeung 31/30 separation), the Segre quadric Q^+(3,F_q) dichotomy (K_{m,m} in SUB_{2m} vs kappa_{POLY_{2m}}(K_{m,m}-e)>=9/8), the Rem #4 (G800) transversal separation (17/16 in POLY_7, 13/12 in CB_7 via F_4, isometric in M_7^{q,+} via an F_2^4-spread state), the two universal obstructions QFail1 (21/20) and QFail2 (41/40) with matching Table 3 26-orbit pure-state QCONE_7 primals satisfying MET_7, and the m=3..18 K_{m,m}-M odd/even parity staircase (Table 4 and Table 5) matching the partial sums toward (5-e)/2. Two minor expository slips appear in the Def. 1.2 closure justification (p. 3) and symmetry-reduction statement (p. 13), and key general-m asymptotics and physical M_{2m}^q realizations remain open.
strengths: Proposition 1.3 cleanly reduces QCONE_n to n(n-1)2^{n-3} + n*2^{n-2} elemental SSA+WM inequalities (896 at n=7), including subadditivity and nonnegativity via purification.

Theorem 2.1 gives an exact n<=6 phase diagram with explicit witnesses: K_{2,3} in CB_5^+, K_{3,3}-e in CB_6^+ and Gamma_6 (Table 2 D4 Farkas proof + closed-form h attaining 9/8), and Orbit 9 Zhang-Yeung 31/30 separation.
Theorem 3.1(1) proves K_{m,m} in SUB_{2m} for all m>=1 via reguli of Q^+(3,F_q) alongside a sharp K_{m,m}-e polymatroid fracture (>=9/8 for m>=3).
Theorem 3.1(3) isolates Rem #4 (G800) separating POLY_7 (17/16) and CB_7 (13/12 via 5-cycle F_4>=0) from M_7^{q,+} via an explicit F_2^4-spread + Bell-pair state.
Theorem 4.1(1) exhibits two minimal universal 7-party quantum obstructions QFail1 (21/20) and QFail2 (41/40) with exact Table 3 pure-state primals and QFail2 dual.
Theorem 4.1(2)-(3) discovers and certifies for m=3..18 a striking odd/even parity staircase on K_{m,m}-M between Q_{2m} and POLY_{2m}, honestly scoping general m>=19 to Open Problem 6.2.
weaknesses: Several key parity-staircase separations at odd m>=5 hold for the outer SSA+WM cone Q_{2m} rather than physically realizable quantum states M_{2m}^q, since non-monotone entropy humps above 3 may be further constrained by inequalities beyond SSA+WM.

Heavy reliance on computational enumeration for full 1736-ray POLY_6 completeness and the 853-graph n=7 census, while auxiliary certificates (QFail1 36-term dual, Rem #4 44-term Shannon dual and CB_7^+ primal, CB_6^+ witnesses for Orbits 6-7) are only in external code.
The asymptotic (5-e)/2 staircase formula and K_{m,m}-M parity persistence for m>=19, as well as Sep #0 realizability in M_7^{q,+} and expander distortion bounds, remain unproven open problems.
potential_errors: Minor slip in Def. 1.2 closure justification (p. 3): n independent fair classical bits have S(X)=|X| and yield 2*1 rather than 1 (though 2*1 is equally in int(MET_n), and biased H=1/2 bits give 1).

Minor gap in Def. 1.2 closure argument (p. 3): citing convexity of the closures of quantum entropy projections alone does not yield closure(K) cap MET_n = closure(K cap MET_n); convexity of K = Pi_n(Sigma_n^*) itself is needed (which holds via orthogonal mixture flags as in Example 1.1).

Minor omission on p. 13 (Theorem 4.1 proof, Part 2): the symmetry-reduction equivalence for Q_{2m} omits stating that Pi_{2m}(S) must also satisfy MET_{2m} triangle inequalities; for K_{m,m}-M this holds automatically because optimal primals achieve (kappa, 2, 3) in MET_{2m}.

Segre quadric Q^+(3,F_q) bipartite realization K_{m,m} in SUB_{2m} for all m>=1 vs K_{m,m}-e fracture outside POLY_{2m} for all m>=3.
Transversal n=7 separation between POLY_7, M_7^{cb}, and M_7^{q,+} at Rem #4 (G800), plus minimal universal 7-party quantum obstructions QFail1 and QFail2.
Exact odd/even parity staircase on K_{m,m}-M (m=3..18) driven by bipartition bisection under Weak Monotonicity and purification, matching partial sums toward (5-e)/2.
